_help: The character info window (official MapleStory art, UICharacterInfo.img). x/y = the window top-left in 1366x768 game pixels; w/h = the whole window (the top block is 472x230, the bottom block 472x479). topX/topY = the top block. blockX/blockY = the bottom block. stripX/stripY = the STAT strip (450x20). bodyX/bodyY = the stats page inside the bottom block (the page art is 448x406). closeX/closeY = the X button, window-local. titleH = the strip at the window top that drags the window. feetX/feetY = the portrait's feet; nameX/nameY = the name plate center and its top (the official plate is 89x19); lvX/lvY/lvW = the level line center, its top and its max width; jobX/jobY = the job name center and its top (the official job pill); jobW = the job name's max width (it is cut with two dots past it). cpX/cpY = the combat power number, the right edge of the number and its top, page-local. The stat rows: each area is two columns (left, right); the column x/w = the hover box, the column vx = the right edge of the number, y/pitch = the first row and the row pitch. The rows per area are fixed by the official label art (3, 8 and 3). main = HP/MP/STR/DEX/INT/LUK, atk = the attack stats, util = mesos and exp. The item tooltip (the hovered bag or equipment icon): detailIconX/detailIconY/detailIconSize = the item icon in the box; detailBustSize = the box of the hair or face bust; detailIconGap = the gap between the icon and the text; detailNameX/detailNameY = the item name; detailLineX/detailLineY/detailLineGap = the stat lines under the name. DEBUG builds reload this file live on save.
